description: Pass a complimentary 48-hour HOLD REQUEST to the owner, who arranges it with Paradise Yacht Clearing (our clearing house). This does NOT confirm anything: Paradise checks the calendar, places the hold and sends the charter contract. Only call after the guest has given their name, email, dates and party size and asked you to request the hold.

broker.description: Name of the broker or travel advisor they work with, if any

email.description: Guest's email (defaults to the email the guest gave at the start)

notes.description: Occasion, preferences or questions for Paradise (optional)

requester.description: Optional: who this request is for, so the owner can follow up personally.

name: request_hold
title: Request a 48-hour hold
